name: Pacifica Breeze Cafe
notes: All 4 photos are clear laminated/printed menu boards. Photos 1 and 4 are two different-era printings of the same breakfast/extras/coffee/cocktails menu with different prices; used photo 1 (higher, apparently current prices) as the canonical version for overlapping items and added the few dishes unique to photo 4 (Wild Mushroom Omelet, Breeze Huevos, 12 Hour Cold Brew). Photo 2 is a separate coffee/specialty-drinks/teas/treats board. Photo 3 is the lunch menu (12-3pm); its Wines by the Glass list was skipped as a drink-only section.
